2609.30935.title: Estimating and Orthogonalizing Unknown Pre-training Gradients for Continual Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
2609.30935.paper_summary: Continual fine-tuning is essential for large language models (LLMs) to dynamically adapt to real-world environments, yet it inevitably suffers from catastrophic forgetting, particularly the performance degradation of previous tasks and LLMs' general-purpose knowledge. Although existing methods, such as orthogonal gradient projection, mitigate the forgetting across various fine-tuning tasks, they fundamentally fail to preserve pre-training LLMs' inherent general-purpose knowledge because the original data and gradients of off-the-shelf pre-training LLMs required by these methods are strictly unknown and highly diverse. To bridge this critical gap, we propose EoupCT, a novel framework designed to Estimate and Orthogonalize Unknown Pre-training gradients for Continual LLM fine-Tuning. Specifically, EoupCT estimates pre-training gradients by dynamically generating pseudo data that is most susceptible to forgetting for new tasks through a learnable soft prompt equipped with Gumbel-Softmax relaxation. Furthermore, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem and introduce a first-order efficient Pareto optimizer that jointly optimizes LLM parameters and the soft prompt, rigorously enforcing orthogonality between new task updates and the estimated pre-training gradients. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that EoupCT effectively preserves both task-specific proficiency and inherent general-purpose knowledge, successfully mitigating the catastrophic forgetting.
2609.30935.paper_summary_zh: 持續的微調對於大型語言模型（LLMs）在真實世界環境中動態適應至關重要，但它不可避免地會遭遇災難性遺忘，特別是先前任務的性能下降和LLMs的通用知識。儘管現有方法，如正交梯度投影，能在各種微調任務中減輕遺忘，但它們根本無法保留預訓練LLMs固有的通用知識，因為這些方法所需的現成預訓練LLMs的原始數據和梯度是完全未知且高度多樣的。為了彌補這一關鍵差距，我們提出了EoupCT，一個旨在為持續LLM微調估計和正交化未知預訓練梯度的新框架。具體而言，EoupCT通過動態生成對新任務最易遺忘的伪數據來估計預訓練梯度，這是通過配備Gumbel-Softmax放鬆的可學習軟提示實現的。此外，我們制定了一個多目標優化問題，並引入了一個一階高效的Pareto優化器，該優化器共同優化LLM參數和軟提示，嚴格強制新任務更新與估計的預訓練梯度之間的正交性。在多個LLM上的廣泛實驗表明，EoupCT有效地保留了任務特定的專業能力和固有的通用知識，成功減輕了災難性遺忘。
